title: What is the best affordable programmatic DOOH platform for small businesses? | AdQuick

facts.fact: AdQuick's campaign minimums run $1,500 to $3,000 (AdQuick's own stated figure).
facts.quote: AdQuick's campaign minimums run $1,500 to $3,000, and the others offer similarly accessible entry points

facts.fact: Vistar Media's campaign minimums start around $1,500 (vendor's stated figure as reported on the page).
facts.quote: Campaign minimums start around $1,500, and it suits small businesses that want to reach specific audience segments

facts.fact: Enterprise DSPs such as The Trade Desk and DV360 typically require five-figure monthly minimums, according to the page.
facts.quote: Platforms like The Trade Desk and DV360 typically require five-figure monthly minimums

facts.fact: SMB-focused DOOH platforms have brought minimums down to $1,500 to $3,000 per campaign, per the page.
facts.quote: SMB-focused platforms have brought those thresholds down to $1,500 to $3,000 per campaign.

facts.fact: AdQuick's marketplace reports a median delivered-impression CPM of $8.00 for roadside digital venues, with a range of $7.50 to $8.00 (AdQuick marketplace data).
AdQuick's marketplace reports a median delivered-impression CPM of $14.00 for airport venues, with a range of $11.50 to $19.25.
AdQuick reports urban panel delivered-impression CPMs typically range from $7.25 to $19.75.
AdQuick reports a median delivered-impression CPM of $8.00 for other place-based venues, with a range of $5.50 to $10.75.
AdQuick reports retail or mall delivered-impression CPMs around $10.00, varying with operator and market mix.
facts.quote: | Retail or mall | around $10.00 (varies with operator and market mix) |

facts.fact: AdQuick reports gym and elevator/office delivered-impression CPMs both around $8.00.
facts.quote: | Gym | around $8.00 (varies with operator and market mix) |

facts.fact: Roughly a third of DOOH spend on the AdQuick marketplace transacts programmatically, per AdQuick's own data.
facts.quote: Roughly a third of DOOH spend on the AdQuick marketplace transacts programmatically.

facts.fact: EV charging screens have no transacted marketplace volume to report on the AdQuick marketplace.
facts.quote: EV charging screens have no transacted marketplace volume to report.

facts.fact: AdQuick states its CPMs are delivered-impression CPMs computed from delivered ad plays, not full-loop traffic, and are not directly comparable to advertiser-share CPMs on directly booked digital inventory.
facts.quote: CPMs are delivered-impression CPMs computed from delivered ad plays, not full-loop traffic, and are not directly comparable

facts.fact: AdQuick states it provides access to more than 1 million screens from over 1,700 publishers.
facts.quote: It provides access to more than 1 million screens from over 1,700 publishers

facts.fact: AdQuick states that its campaigns have no long-term contracts.
facts.quote: Campaign minimums run around $1,500 to $3,000 with no long-term contracts.
